load_meshes_from_glb: load all meshes from a GLB file and return them as a list of named Meshes objects
register_glb_format_with_io: register MeshGlbFormat with pytorch3d IO to load .glb files via io.load_mesh
read_glb_header: read and validate the GLB file header to extract version and length from a binary stream
parse_glb_chunks: parse JSON and binary chunks from a GLB container file given the file length
build_node_transform: build a Transform3d object from a glTF node's scale, rotation quaternion, and translation
